**CRM Lead Intake Form**

**Internal Sales CRM Lead Creation Form**

***Used by Sales Teams, Channel Partners, Call Center Executives,
Marketing Teams & AI Agents***

**Purpose:** This form is used internally to create, enrich, qualify,
and manage every lead entering the CRM. It serves as the single source
of truth for the sales pipeline and enables AI-powered lead scoring,
routing, automation, and forecasting.

**🤖 AI Agents Powered by This Form**

This single intake form can drive multiple specialized AI agents:

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **AI Agent**     **Function**
  ---------------- ------------------------------------------------------
  **Lead           Scores and classifies incoming leads.
  Qualification    
  Agent**          

  **Buyer Persona  Creates a detailed customer profile and investment
  Agent**          persona.

  **Property       Recommends the most suitable inventory based on
  Matching Agent** preferences and budget.

  **Sales Copilot  Suggests talking points, handles objections, and
  Agent**          recommends next actions during sales conversations.

  **Follow-up      Schedules and executes personalized WhatsApp, email,
  Automation       SMS, and reminder workflows.
  Agent**          

  **Revenue        Predicts deal value, expected close date, and pipeline
  Forecasting      health.
  Agent**          

  **Marketing      Tracks the full customer journey from campaign to
  Attribution      booking and measures marketing effectiveness.
  Agent**          

  **CRM            Continuously enriches lead profiles, detects
  Intelligence     duplicates, prioritizes opportunities, and surfaces
  Agent**          actionable insights to the sales team.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

This structure transforms a traditional CRM intake form into the
operational backbone of an **AI-native Real Estate Sales & Marketing
Operating System**, where every new lead immediately activates a network
of intelligent agents that assist marketing, sales, customer success,
and leadership.
